title: Cubefault
description: my 100 subs texture pack revamps some weapons and tools to be more dynamic for pvp
body:
this is my 100 subs texture pack https://www.youtube.com/@CuberMC_official thats my yt channel this texture pack changes some weapons and tools to be more dynamic for pvp and it even has diffrent textures for the maces enchants
this texture pack affects the following
all hoes
all shovels
all swords
all axes
all pickaxes
exluding copper tools
mace has 3 textures
density has its own texture
breach also has its own texture
and the unenchanted mace ovs has a custom texture
if both breach and density is on the same mace then expect glitches
